runs.adapter: D3D12 WARP (Microsoft Basic Render Driver 10.0.26100.9587), debug layer on
runs.result: fail on every scene. Controls fail as required on every scene (offset: 16,730 to 35,821 unexplained; rotation: 120,481 to 133,859). Main bound missed for three causes:
causes: TMin defect in WARP (20 unexplained: terrain 2, hall 1, debris 17). Every sampled case (10 of 20) is a GPU hit with t below TMin 1e-4 (largest 8.7e-5). Reproduced in isolation with a scratch program: debris ray 191018 against its single triangle 11668 returns t 4.275e-5 with TMin 1e-4 and still with TMin 1e-3, while an axis-aligned ray against a single triangle respects TMin for both windings. The CPU's Moeller-Trumbore gives t 4.27487e-5 for the same pair and rejects it below its 1e-4 floor. Inferred: WARP does not apply TMin for some ray directions. Not yet checked on hardware.

Coplanar geometry in the hall scene: 885 ties and 3 edges explained (2.6e-3 of the rays, bound 1e-3). Column bottom caps and stair bottoms are coplanar with the floor, so CPU and GPU pick different coincident triangles. The scene and the bound are kept as committed; the fraction bound fails on this scene by design of the scene.

Two agreeing hits outside tolerance, both near-grazing: hall ray 184095 (t 1.17x, uv 1.65x of tolerance, |det| 2.9e-4) and debris ray 112564 (t 2.42x, |det| 1.6e-5). The committed tolerances have no grazing-angle conditioning term.
